scope: MR-09 complete at the committed archive/output boundary: immutable namespace/birth/schema-bound recovery sets, canonical metadata, full object/dependency readback and physical replay before conditional heads; exact local-prefix core archive proofs; Quorum/S3/minimum/stronger retry settlement; node-owned bounded scheduling, I/O deadlines and cancellation; retained images, startup reference reconciliation and deferred committed apply under capacity pressure. This does not complete the original 17-package goal.
environment: macOS-26.5.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O; real SQLite/LTX/Raft Engine, InMemory conditional-write fault store and durable local bucket; native Node/SDK plus real three-voter TLS TCP isolation/healing and external native/Axum restart drill; independent producer/verifier/restore directories; isolated checkout target; no cellar_internal_tests
limitations: MR-09 only; MR-10 through MR-17 and the full goal remain unachieved. Physical S3, power loss, zones, production capacity/performance and complete release/scaling qualification are not established by local fixtures. ArchiveRecoverySet reconstructs a cell image and receipt/dependency material; it does not atomically install Raft state, authorize membership, restore votes/process identity or provide disaster-restore admission. Those remain MR-10/MR-11/MR-13. Explicit dependency bytes are tested; managed Blob/effect closure enumeration remains MR-12 and unsupported SDK capabilities stay refused. The 256-MiB aggregate backlog cap is new-command admission, not total process/disk usage; incoming Raft data and images also have their transport/log/per-store hard bounds, with broader operational watermarks/reporting still MR-13. Quorum acknowledgements may leave an unarchived tail; closing is not permission to delete such disks. Native callbacks/providers are trusted/cooperative, not OS sandboxed. Six ignored process child entry points are invoked by owning parents and excluded from counts. Existing vendored warnings remain visible.
